basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old data analyst from Portland, Oregon, with a newfound love for true crime podcasts. I stumbled upon Reddit while looking for communities that share my interests—particularly 'My Favorite Murder.' When I'm not diving into crime stories, I enjoy hiking, tinkering with my Wrangler TJ, and expanding my coding skills in Python. I'm usually online in the evenings after work. Currently single, and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies and communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Data Science and have been working in the field for about three years. My interest in coding led me to self-teaching Python, recently focusing on data analysis and automation scripts. My fascination with the human microbiome has also driven me to research and participate in related forums.
